singleImageHint: Describe your image, choose a style and review the cost. Results are saved in the Single images project.
accessNoActive: No active access grants. Revoked grants are in the history.
accessHistoryHint: These grants are already invalid and do not need to be revoked again.
apiKeyHelp: Where do I get an API key?
apiKeyHelpGemini: Sign in to Google AI Studio and create a key under API Keys. Select or create a Cloud project and enable billing for paid image models.
apiKeyHelpOpenai: Select the correct project in the OpenAI API dashboard and create a new secret key under API keys. Check API billing and model access for that project.
apiKeyHelpAnthropic: In the Claude Console, open Settings → API keys and click Create key. Choose a name and expiration, then copy the key shown once. Claude is used only as a prompt assistant here.
apiKeyHelpPrivacy: Enter the key here, then explicitly save it or activate it for this session. A chat subscription alone does not replace API access.
exportSeriesHint: All saved results in series order. Reference images and other series are excluded. Images still being generated will be available in a later export.
exportSeriesEmpty: This series has no images to export yet.
generationNoPercent: The provider does not report progress percentages per image. This indicator counts saved images.
keychainLocation: macOS: Keychain Access → login → All Items. Search for com.yorkstack.framestudio. Account:
keyStoredVerified: Saved in the OS credential store and successfully read back. No provider request.
seriesKeyCheckFailed: No approval granted or images started. Key access failed for
seriesKeyCheckHelp: Activate this provider's key under Settings → API keys → This session only, then click “Use for this session”. Selected provider:
seriesOpenFailed: The series was approved, but its project could not be opened yet. Please use “Open project and jobs”.
seriesSessionRequired: This series uses a session key. Only the app holding that key can process it. Enter the session key again after restarting; the series approval is retained.
seriesApprovalIntro: Review the complete request. One approval covers all listed images, generated sequentially.
seriesEmpty: No series requests. MCP and API clients can submit a complete image list here for approval.
settingsGeneralHint: Choose the appearance and interaction mode of your workshop.
settingsProvidersHint: Connect image providers and the optional prompt assistant. Key actions take effect immediately and do not start generation.
settingsStorageHint: Choose where projects and exports are stored and how files are named.
settingsBudgetHint: All amounts in USD. These limits apply to the GUI, REST and MCP.
settingsPricingHint: Compare pricing and check the public provider sources.
settingsAccessHint: Enable local interfaces and manage named access tokens. Provider keys are separate from access tokens.
settingsUnsaved: Unsaved settings. Save applies changes from all sections.
settingsImmediateHint: Keys, tokens and pricing updates use their own action buttons.
keychainCheckHint: “Check keychain only” tests the stored entry even if a session key is active.
keychainReadable: The keychain entry is readable by this app. No provider request or cost.
seriesModelHint: Choose a configured provider for the whole series. The active session key or stored key is used. Prompts, references and aspect ratios are retained. Claude does not generate images.
seriesQuoteFailed: No valid cost preview. Reopen the dialog and check settings.
seriesOneTimeLimit: Allow a one-time start limit for this series:
seriesWarning: This series reaches the configured cost warning threshold.
seriesApprovalScope: Approval covers exactly this image list, prompts and price basis. The total estimated budget is reserved at start. Actual costs may differ; local limits do not block provider billing.
subtitle: Your local graphics workshop
projectOverviewBody: All active projects in one place. Open a project to work on its images.
promptAIAll: Split into three sections / improve with AI
promptAIAllHint: The displayed text will be split into scene, characters and individual instruction. All three results can be edited before applying. This is a paid request, started only by clicking the button.
promptAIOnlyTarget: Only the displayed text and your change request are sent. Other sections and image references remain unchanged.
appInfoHint: Version and software inventory of this build.
sbomHint: CycloneDX 1.6: all locked npm/Cargo dependencies, including build tools and platform packages. Does not scan the OS or include projects or keys.
projectTrashHint: The project disappears from the gallery. Images, history and costs remain in the local trash and can be restored.
characterPortraitHint: Choose a generated cover image. This does not change generation references.
promptSceneHint: Environment and design shared by all variants of this draft.
promptScenePlaceholder: For example: A LEGO spaceship hovers over a bright hangar. Soft light, calm background.
promptCharacterHint: Who is in the image? Choose a saved character or describe their features below.
promptCharacterDefinition: Saved character definition · included in request
promptCharacterNotesHint: Only for this draft. Adds to the saved character definition without replacing it.
promptCharacterPlaceholder: For example: A second pilot with a brown beard, green suit and gray bow tie. Both figures are plastic minifigures.
promptCharacterReferencesActive: Approved character references are included automatically. Change them via “Edit saved character”.
promptCharacterReferencesInactive: These character references are not approved for sending yet.
promptImageReferencesHint: Choose additional image references for this draft or remove them with ×.
promptInstructionHint: Required: What should this image show? Series variants add to this instruction.
promptInstructionPlaceholder: For example: Show both pilots waving in the cockpit, facing forward with open eyes.
promptAssistantHint: Here Claude improves only the individual instruction. Scene and character have their own AI actions.
openaiApiHint: Requires an OpenAI API key. Usage is billed through your OpenAI API account; a ChatGPT login alone is not enough.
modelParametersChanged: Unsupported settings were adjusted for this model:
noProjectBody: Create a project. Collect references, develop a style and shape your images.
noAssets: Your first image starts on the right.
noAssetsBody: Describe your idea or import a reference image. Originals are always preserved.
stylePreviewPromptHint: Using the same subject makes styles comparable. Style components are added automatically. Changes are versioned.
stylePreviewBody: Review the subject, provider and cost. Generate an image and adopt a result that represents your style.
stylePreviewTest: Test image · not a style evaluation
stylePreviewUncertain: A previous job has an uncertain outcome and may have incurred costs. Starting again can incur additional costs. There is no automatic retry.
providerNeedsKey: Configure a key for this provider in Settings or activate one for this session.
stylePreviewJobNotice: Jobs persist after closing. Find them in the Style previews project. Cancelling provider requests is best effort.
stylePreviewRemoved: Preview removed. The original image is preserved.
stylePreviewGalleryHint: The preview illustrates the style. It is not automatically sent to the provider as a reference.
name: Name
title: Title
keyUnavailable: Key status unavailable · check OS credential store
keyStored: Key stored · read access not yet checked
costNotice: Local limits do not replace a provider-wide billing limit.
consistency: Image models cannot guarantee perfect identity or frame consistency.
upscale: Increasing pixel dimensions does not create additional real image detail.
testNotice: Test provider: local, deterministic test images. No AI generation or API costs.
approveUnknown: I approve a request with an unknown price.
savedLocally: Your projects and images stay on this computer.
apiPrivacy: Only explicitly selected content is sent to the provider for generation.
immutable: Every job stores an immutable snapshot of its prompt, references and price basis.
keyModeSession: This session only · do not save
keySessionRemoved: Session key removed. Requests already sent continue; the stored key may be used afterward.
keySessionPriority: The session key takes priority. Select “This session only” to remove it. Persisted keys remain stored.
keySessionHint: Kept only in the memory of this running app, without keychain access. Discarded when the app fully quits; closing Settings does not remove it. Activation starts no jobs. Costs and budget limits still apply.
keySessionFieldHint: Not stored in files, projects or browser storage. The input is cleared after activation.
keyPending: Accessing credential store. Please wait for the result; there is no automatic retry.
keyDeleted: Key removed from the OS credential store.
keyPreflightFailed: No job started or provider request sent.
keyReadable: This app can read the key. No provider request sent; provider validity has not been checked.
keyCheckHint: Checks local access only, without image generation or costs. The key is not displayed.
keyNoDialogs: FrameStudio does not automatically open keychain dialogs. If the store is locked or access denied, an error appears here.
keyAccessHelp: On macOS use Keychain Access, not the Passwords app. Check com.yorkstack.framestudio and its access control for the current FrameStudio app. An unlocked keychain can still deny app access, for example after an update. Alternatively choose “This session only” and enter the key again. Do not reset the keychain or grant access to all apps.
tokenOnce: The token is shown only once. Store it securely in your API client.
keyHint: Only in the OS credential store. Saved keys are never returned to the UI.
noToken: No token stored in the UI.
restoreHint: A project package contains originals and a versioned manifest. Importing never overwrites existing projects.
exportHint: Originals remain unchanged. New files are created without overwriting.
noReference: Import a reference image into the project first.
referenceUploadHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or TIFF. Originals stay in the project. New photos are selected for this request; uploading alone sends nothing to an image provider.
referenceLimit: Deselect references first. Maximum for this model:
confirmArchive: Archive project? Images and costs are preserved.
noCharacters: No characters in this project yet.
automatedHint: REST and MCP share budgets and job rules. Activation applies to new connections.
exportError: The export could not be created.
requestUnclear: There is no automatic paid retry after an uncertain provider result.
noPercent: The provider does not report progress percentages.
noPaid: Without a key you can explore the entire workshop using the test provider.
costUnknown: Missing usage data does not mean zero cost.
exportNoAssets: There are no images for this export yet.
titleLength: Long descriptions are shortened in the gallery and remain complete in the detail view.
automationRisk: This approval allows local API/MCP clients to start paid requests within your limits.
anthropicKeyHint: This key is used only for the optional Claude prompt assistant. Claude does not generate images.
pricingIntro: Compare image output costs and token prices. Refresh checks public provider information only; no API key is required.
pricingPartial: Some providers could not be refreshed. Their last valid price basis is retained.
pricingUpdated: Provider information checked. New jobs use the updated price basis.
pricingOutputOnly: Image output only; prompts, references and possible text/thinking output cost extra.
pricingPerMillion: USD per 1 million tokens · standard processing
pricingCopyFailed: Could not copy the URL. Select and copy the displayed source manually.
pricingNotice: Estimates are not invoices or guaranteed caps. Historical jobs retain their price basis. Failed refreshes never overwrite prices.
claudeNoImages: No image generation. Claude is a text assistant for image descriptions; billing is token-based.
assistantIntro: Request a suggestion for your image description. Review and apply the result yourself. This does not start image generation.
assistantOnlyDescription: Only this description and your change request are sent. Style components, character data and reference images remain unchanged.
assistantInstructionExample: For example: Clarify the composition, preserve details and write in English.
assistantTestNotice: The test assistant processes text locally and incurs no API costs.
assistantPrivacy: Only “Request suggestion” sends the displayed text to Anthropic. Your own Anthropic API key is required.
assistantNoResult: The suggestion will appear here after your explicit request.
assistantUncertain: The outcome is uncertain and costs may have been incurred. No automatic retry.
assistantTooLong: The suggestion exceeds 12,000 characters and will not be truncated automatically.
assistantCloseNotice: The job persists after closing. Status and text remain available in the job list and local API. Cancellation of running requests is best effort.
accessIntro: Create a named grant for each person or program to track usage and revocation.
accessScopeHint: Access applies only to the selected interfaces. Spending also requires local approval and available budget.
accessSecretHint: Visible only now. Copy the token to your client or password manager. After hiding or closing, it cannot be shown again.
accessHidden: Token hidden. The named grant can still be managed below.
accessCopyFailed: Could not copy the token. Select and copy the displayed value manually.
accessRevokedNotice: This grant is revoked. Other grants remain valid.
accessEmpty: No access grants yet. Create a named grant for each client; creation dates are recorded automatically.
accessMcpHint: For MCP choose an MCP grant and pass the token to your local client as an environment variable:
accessPrivacy: Provider API keys do not belong here. Never put tokens in Git, screenshots or shared configurations. The inventory stores metadata and a hash, not a readable token.
